search_notes: About 40 searches and fetches, in Spanish and English. No active Mexican food truck Facebook group could be found with a name, URL and member count, because search engines don't index the groups. No regional association has a published email. Not included: the Tecate Food Truck Fest in Monterrey (a Heineken brand event, 40+ trucks, 2025-08-02), the Expo Food Trucks in Nezahualcóyotl (run by the municipality, Dec 2025), the FoodTrucksMx X account (which speaks for the already-known Asociación Mexicana de Food Trucks, with posts from 2016) and Canirac (a general restaurant chamber).

orgs.name: Festival Paladares (formerly Festival del Gordo)
orgs.region: Monterrey, Nuevo León (also editions in Guadalajara)
orgs.members_estimate: 100+ restaurants and food trucks at the 2026 edition (playersoflife.com, Feb 2026); 30+ food trucks at the Guadalajara Festival del Gordo, Nov 2025 (liderempresarial.com)
orgs.notes: A food festival organiser with a large vendor roster. The 2026 edition was 2–3 May at Parque Fundidora. The Instagram handle comes from the festival's post embedded in the article. No website or email was found.

orgs.name: Telefónica Gastro Park
orgs.members_estimate: About 9 food truck and stall concepts listed in a 2022 article (ediblesandiego.com)
orgs.notes: Tijuana's best-known food truck park, founded in 2014, and a Canirac member. The site lists a phone (663 112 1835) and WhatsApp (wa.me/526631181235) but no email. The newest dated evidence is a 2022 article and a 2021 site footer, so by the rule it counts as inactive, although it probably still trades.

orgs.name: Asociación de Food Trucks (Tijuana), president Fernando Acosta
orgs.notes: Only one source, a Nov 2024 podcast page seen as a search snippet, calls Fernando Acosta 'president of the Association of Food Trucks' in Tijuana. Two more searches found no full name, page or contact.

orgs.name: Foodtruck Guadalajara Asociación
orgs.notes: Listed in a Zapopan directory of organisations, with posts from 2022 about jobs and street-vending rules (from a search snippet). The page didn't load (TLS error), and no social account was found.

orgs.name: El Camionero (food truck park)
orgs.members_estimate: About 20 trucks, each paying 12,000 pesos a month (Guadalajara Reporter, undated)
orgs.notes: A food truck park opposite Andares mall (Av. de los Empresarios 135). It rents pitches to about 20 trucks. No dated evidence or social account was found.

orgs.name: Food Truck Park Guadalajara
orgs.notes: The city's first food truck park (Niños Héroes and Chapultepec), with up to 1,500 visitors a weekend. Articles are undated and no official social account was found.

orgs.name: Colectivo 9
orgs.notes: A street food collective of nine chef-run stalls on Avenida Revolución, opened in 2014. All coverage is from 2014 to 2017.

orgs.name: World Food Truck Festival Mérida
orgs.notes: A recurring food truck festival ('returns'), held 5–8 Sep 2024 at the Acueducto de Los Milagros. The organiser is not named, the article page failed to load (522), and no social account was found.
